about: The Graph Spec's version (editor spec §51, spec_versioned). The rules are requirements/graph-spec.gql. A change to the rules makes a new version: a line below with the decision that made it, the owner's approval and the rules' new hash, which 'node scripts/graph-spec-version.mjs --hash' prints. test/graph-spec-version.test.js fails a change to the rules without one. A newer major version is one a reader of the older major refuses (GN107).

changelog.what: The first numbered version: the 212 rules as the owner froze them on 19 Oct 2026, with the axioms of section 28 added on 28 Oct 2026.
changelog.decision: Panel review group B, graph-spec-review: version the spec as Graph Spec 1.0

changelog.what: One removal rule (a change set may remove or change anything but a record or a cache) and one place that states who proposed. Six display rules: local ids shown with their graph, corrected judgements, AI challenges only when asked, gentle shown names, likelihood words with their range, and a one-sentence altitude.
changelog.decision: Digest D5-D7: GS5 #781, gentle words #784, display rules #785

changelog.what: An erratum, no rule changed in meaning: three rules' words the paste cut short or marked, and seven decision names that lost an apostrophe, each put back from the owner's original. requirements/graph-spec-erratum.json lists each repair.
changelog.decision: #767 spec_text_restored: restore the paste damage from the owner's original (graph-spec-review recommendation 5)

withdrawn.note: The graph spec has no section 2. The number is kept as withdrawn, so every citation of the other sections stays true.
